functions.why: How every counter is printed in a text Profile: decimals, padding, unit suffix
Text Profile indentation, info strings, child order
Text Profile layout: node header, (Active: …) line, info strings, counter tree (class was spelled DefaultProfileFormater before 3.1)
How per-instance profiles merge into the MergedProfile (min/max/avg)
Official output rows of a plan node
Default merge strategy per counter unit

capabilities.why: Profiles can be read as JSON
Audit events carry the official digest
The execution section header is `Execution:`; before it, `Execution Profile <query id>:`
Summary `Query State` is Finished/Running/Error; before it, the MySQL state type name (NOOP/OK/EOF/ERR)
Merged fragment profiles list InstanceIds next to BackendAddresses
An operator with a negative plan node id is named without `(plan_node_id=…)`: the bare name for a sink in the plan, `(pseudo_plan_node_id=…)` outside the plan
